text:
Maya: Heads-up: starting an ownership sprint to hand back stale admin grants and gather audit evidence for SOC2. kicking off today, 2-week window.
Liam: SGTM — what's the exact sampling criteria?
Maya: sampling = last-active > 180d OR missing owner tag. priority: prod-admins, kube-admins, crossacct roles. plan: notify -> 72h for justification -> auto-remove for service accounts.
Sanjay: question: how do we treat KMS grants attached to these roles? can't just drop role if key grants still exist.
Priya: good call. key-policy sweep first. i'll run a grant report and attach to the evidence ticket. command i'll use: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key-id> --query 'Grants[?GranteePrincipal==`'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ROLE'`']'`
Maya: exact playbook (short):
```
1) run ownerless finder: ./tools/find_ownerless_roles.sh --days 180 > ownerless.txt
2) for each role: notify owner via ownership-batch template
3) if svcacct & no response -> create remediation ticket and remove inline policies after kms cleanup
```
Liam: can we automate the notify step with a single zap? ownership-batch template needs the evidence fields filled.
Nina: product/legal want a record of attempted outreach in the ticket. make sure the template includes timestamps and audit log links.
AuditBot: Created SEC-248: "ownership-sprint-evidence" and attached cloudtrail slice + iam-change-diff.
Priya: for KMS handling: i'll freeze grants (disable future grants) and export grant list to S3: `aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --output json > s3://sec-evidence/$K-grants.json` then handoff to infra.
InfraBot: noted. for private/self-hosted clusters we require manual key-admin signoff; please include ops runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/keys-handback
Sanjay: also include a short check to avoid dropping roles with active bindings in Vault or GCP equivalents. i've got a quick grep tool: `./tools/check_cross_service_bindings role-name`
Maya: remediation script draft (internal quick):
```bash
for r in $(cat ownerless.txt); do
  echo "freezing role: $r"
  aws iam tag-role --role-name $r --tags Key=freeze,Value=true
  # revoke inline policies after kms/grant cleanup
done
```
Liam: what's the escalation for contested removals? we need a 24h ping to EngInfra + Sec leads before forced removal.
Maya: yes — contested => escalate to #eng-security oncall and create high-priority ticket. keep removal blocked until approval.
Nina: reminder: for SOC2 we must keep proof of attempted contact (email headers) and the exact iam change payloads. attach to SEC-248.
Priya: i'll drop the initial key-grant reports into SEC-248 and mark roles that require manual approval.
AuditBot: SEC-248 updated: evidence.csv + ownership-notifications.log added.
Maya: thanks all. I'll post the ownership-batch template after lunch. please run the finder on your areas and tag any false positives. :white_check_mark:
Liam: thumbs up.
Sanjay: i'll start with infra and kube roles.
Priya: starting kms export now.
Nina: looping legal in case of any customer-impact flags.
Maya: we'll sync mid-week in #eng-security. end of thread"
